items.headline: Minchey rallies No. 24 Kentucky to 35-34 OT win at South Caroilna
items.description: — Kenny Minchey threw a 6-yard TD pass to Henry Boyer and a 2-point conversion to Willie Rodriguez as No. 24 Kentucky rallied from 17-0 down to beat South Carolina 35-34 in overtime on Saturday.
